newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet drops with gas oil futures, premiums hold.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet drops with gas oil futures, premiums hold.

text.p: European jet fuel was knocked lower on Thursday by weaker IPE gas oil futures and unchanged premiums.
April IPE gas oil was trading $3 a tonne lower at $162.25 at 1615 GMT in thin afternoon trade.

Jet fuel barge premiums were assessed steady at April IPE +$17.50 fob ARA with cargoes pegged in the low $20s for cif NWE delivery. Most dealers saw NWE as long with good supplies in the barge market and out of the U.K.

In the Mediterranean, sellers of EU grade were looking for fob high quotes +$8-9 against buying interest of fob high quotes +$6-7. Libyan was pegged around high fob quotes +46/7 on the offer side with bids up to $3 a tonne lower.
"There's a wide spread between buyers and sellers, but trades will probably get done nearer sellers' levels," said one broker.
The market was seen to be fairly quiet with dealers in no great hurry to conclude trades.
